text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Pelago onboarding — during their peak sync window p99 spikes to ~1.6s on bursty sessions (700rps). p50/p95 fine. Want to push a low-risk mitigation before their partner demo next Tue.

Luis (Infra): do we have traces? could be KV eviction or long prefix handling. If it's long-context, route those to a compact-lite quantized variant.

Maya (CS): redacted trace: `trace://pelago/2026-03-25/slotB` shows long rolling history + reconnect backfills + streaming.

Ravi (ML): compact-lite-int8 (bias-corrected, per-channel) kept eval quality within 0.8% on our suite and trimmed median latency ~25% in bench. p99 gains depend on prefetched KV hits.

Luis (Infra): Suggested plan: 1) prefix-aware rule: if ctx.tokens>900 or tag=backfill -> compact-lite-int8, 2) 4% canary for 12h in staging, 3) enable session-affinity + prefix-prefetch(keep=4). config snippet: `rule: ctx.tokens>900 -> route:compact-lite-int8 canary:0.04 duration:12h`.

Nora (Account): renewal check-in in 4 weeks. if we show stable tail improvement during demo that will help renewal convo. any customer-visible risk?

Ravi (ML): small risk of distribution drift on adversarial long-chains. mitigation: run a focused drift eval on their sanitized prompts and gate canary with rollback if drift >1.5% on our eval metric. I'll deliver matrix by EOD.

infra-bot: ticket INF-4600 created for canary configuration; staging quota verified.

Luis (Infra): action owners: Ravi = eval + matrix, Luis = canary config + alerts, Maya = customer opt-in & prompt set, Nora = renewal comms. I'll wire automated rollback on drift threshold and alert if p99>1.5s for 10m.

Maya (CS): thanks team. goal: reproducible ~20-30% tail improvement for demo. I'll prep a one-pager for Pelago if numbers look good. :thumbsup:
